description: Land Acquisition - Kohila Wagura, Karandeniya D/S Division, Galle District - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1908/31 of 01.04.2015 by Kandy Four Gravets & Gangawata Korale D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains specific notices about government acquisition of land for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of the land parcels, ownership details, and procedures for compensation claims. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it concerns land acquisition, property ownership transfers, and related administrative procedures for land matters.
